hypothesis: Request224 failed because pullback onset is too early to know whether the reversal is healthy. Paying for exactly one observed event should reveal early depth, speed, recovery, and microstructure changes that transfer better.

probe_policy.at_pullback_onset: always observe exactly one additional actual event
probe_policy.if_still_pullback: score eligibility using first-post-onset causal shape

eligibility_target: Value at first causal reacceleration or 30-minute cap minus EXIT at the first post-onset decision state.

threshold_selection.objective: maximum day-balanced local uplift measured from original pullback onset

forbidden: using more than one probe event before the eligibility decision
changing the threshold grid after seeing Request178
using terminal value or future event timing as model input
tuning Request223 zero WAIT threshold on Request178
ignoring the P&L cost of the one-event probe
next_if_pass: Freeze the one-event probe gate, then build the reacceleration continuation/exit handoff and replay full Request208-entry trajectories.
next_if_fail: Stop local pullback gate refinements and move upstream to improve entry timing so fewer weak positions reach pullback management.

rerun.reason: Handle immediate terminal probe segments with no first-post-onset decision row.
